first_unrecovered_deviation.summary: Lyapunov-sensitive MD trajectory divergence while ensemble statistics remained consistent.

primary_root_cause.summary: Floating-point/parallel accumulation caused pointwise MD trajectory drift despite valid ensemble statistics.

contributing_factors.summary: Verifier compared instantaneous late-step coordinates/energies rather than ensemble averages.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Lyapunov-sensitive MD trajectory divergence across float accumulation while ensemble averages match.
competing_hypotheses.counterfactual_test: Compare ensemble averages or pin MPI/OMP thread counts.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Agent configured wrong ensemble or thermodynamic state.
competing_hypotheses.counterfactual_test: Check ensemble average match reported in `verify.log`.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Agent produced invalid or missing simulation results.
missing_evidence: Positive behavioral, scientific, or contract-mismatch evidence implicating agent decisions
competing_hypotheses.counterfactual_test: Inspect agent trajectory and generated workspace files for explicit errors.

excluded_hypotheses.reason: Agent used the requested parameters and ensemble averages matched reference tolerances; divergence reflects finite-precision floating-point accumulation sensitivity.

recommended_actions.action: Verify ensemble averages or conserved-quantity drift rather than late-step instantaneous values, or pin MPI/OMP thread counts.
